text:
Situation: Sodium acetate has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2016-02-03 and remains current as of 2026-10-21, spanning 129 months. Affected companies named by FDA include Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., Hospira, Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Milla Pharmaceuticals, and Somerset Therapeutics, LLC. Corvale East holds 11.4 days of the 20 mL presentation and 16.5 days of the 50 mL presentation; Corvale General holds 22.1 and 19.5 days respectively.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2016-02-03. Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) was inspected on 2015-09-24 and classified VAI, 132 days before the shortage posting. That same plant later received an OAI classification on 2019-09-06 and a Warning Letter on 2020-03-25, well after the initial posting.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited coverage across both campuses. No supplier on the FDA shortage list is available for immediate replenishment. Several manufacturers not on the shortage list today may offer supply, though their manufacturing sites cannot be verified from product labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals Private Limited — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Requires buyer approval.
2. Evaluate purchase from B. Braun Medical Inc. — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Requires buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Baxter Healthcare Corporation — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Requires buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from ICU Medical Inc. — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Requires buyer approval.
5. Use sodium acetate 164 mg/mL from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (alternate presentation) with pharmacist verification for dose and volume recalculation. Approved by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-08-19. FDA lists this product Current (posted 2016-02-03). Requires pharmacist approval.

Not recommended: No action at this time given declining days on hand and no confirmed resupply dates from listed manufacturers.
